items.title: Breaking: US confirms new 12.5pc tariff for Australia
items.description: The new levy will be placed on exports from later today, superseding the 10 per cent tariff that was expiring. Dozens of other countries will also be hit, but Australia's tariff is among the highest.

items.title: AI has changed what criminals can do with your stolen Origin data
items.description: The theft of names, addresses and phone numbers may seem less serious than stolen bank details, but cyber experts say AI is changing what criminals can do with that information.

items.title: The text warnings about a looming Liberal Party corruption scandal
items.description: Nineteen months before making the parliamentary speech that sparked a corruption inquiry into NSW Liberal figures and their relationship with a fugitive property developer, parliamentary secretary Ray Williams sent an urgent text message to his boss, premier Gladys Berejiklian.

items.title: Conspiracy theories about AusAlert test spreading online
items.description: From wrapping your phone in foil to secret phones, ABC NEWS Verify takes a look into some of these false claims and real concerns about AusAlert to try to answer a few questions.

items.title: Oil prices over $US100 a barrel after Houthi attacks in Red Sea
items.description: The entry of the Houthi rebels into the war between the US and Iran threatens another vital shipping route through the region, as the entire region remains on high alert.

items.title: Live: Commonwealth Games open with tartan, a unicorn and the King in a TARDIS
items.description: The Commonwealth Games are officially opened by King Charles III as many of the 3,000 athletes parade in front of 14,000 spectators. Follow live.

items.title: Automakers in shock as China takes over
items.description: In June, a bulk carrier made an unprecedented delivery of EVs to Australia, sounding an ominous warning to the world's automakers.

items.title: Breaking: First suspected positive case of H5 bird flu detected in Queensland
items.description: It's the first wild, migratory seabird in Queensland to return a suspect positive case for H5 bird flu.

items.title: Security concerns in US over Chinese ships that visit Australia
items.description: Two Chinese polar research ships that make regular port visits in Australia have come under increased scrutiny by US authorities targeting "any detected malign activity".

items.title: Live: New US tariff on Australia 'makes no sense', defence minister says
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles has defended Australia's modern slavery laws after the US said it would slap 12.5 per cent tariffs on Australia. Follow live.

items.title: Zelenskyy just scored an 'own goal' and it cost him big time
items.description: The Ukrainian president's decision to fire his popular, tech-savvy 35-year-old Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov last week baffled many. Analysts say what happens next could be pivotal to the war.

items.title: Small business insolvency rates begin to rise
items.description: Small-to-medium sized businesses have had a challenging year, with increased costs and regulatory reforms. Insolvency rates are beginning to rise and more owners are shopping around for credit.

items.title: Breaking: Worker dead, another injured as truck rolls over vehicle at Queensland mine
items.description: One man is dead and another has been seriously injured after their vehicle was struck by a giant mining truck at a Central Queensland coal site.

items.title: Indonesia's baby traffickers target poor families as demand grows
items.description: Police in Indonesia are more regularly busting baby trafficking and illegal adoption rings, with officials worried poverty may be driving the practice.

items.title: Friday news quiz: World Cup winners, rock legends and Barnaby Joyce's dog
items.description: We have 10 questions to test your knowledge of the week in … SIT DOWN! Sorry, it's the ABC news quiz.

items.title: After Brat, Charli xcx asks a bigger question about legacy
items.description: On her new album Music, Fashion, Film, British artist Charli xcx discusses the enduring legacy of art and artists, and how creative figures are remembered long after their moment has passed.

items.title: Adolescence creator tackles teen rehab very differently in The Good Boy
items.description: Emmy Award-winning Adolescence co-creator Stephen Graham tackles teen delinquency in a very different way in The Good Boy.

items.title: This footy club wants better for its women's team but is in a pinch
items.description: Macedon Football Netball Club is proud to do things its way. But it is in a pinch with its women and girls team.

items.title: Saudi Arabia must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
items.description: Donald Trump is insisting the US deal allowing Saudi Arabia to develop a nuclear energy industry has one major condition — the Arab kingdom must formally recognise the State of Israel.

items.title: Live: ASX set to fall as oil tops $US100
items.description: Australian shares are set to fall as oil prices surge above $US100 a barrel and Wall Street's tech sell-off deepens. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Labor warned regional funding woes will drive One Nation support
items.description: The ALP's 50th National Conference kicked off with the rise of One Nation, local council budgets and regional voter frustrations leading negotiations.

items.title: 'Far more' needs to be done to help children leaving state care
items.description: Queensland Family and Children's Commissioner Luke Twyford says the situation is "profoundly upsetting".

items.title: First nursery for babies of Ebola victims opens in Congo
items.description: The first UNICEF-supported Ebola nursery opens in the Democratic Republic of Congo, supporting young children whose parents have contracted the disease while the number of cases intensifies.

items.title: This is the AFL's most interesting Western Derby in a decade
items.description: Fremantle sits atop the mountain, with one hand firmly grasping the AFL's minor premiership. West Coast is finally showing sustained improvement. Both sides have something to gain; one has a lot to lose.

items.title: Counterfeit notes seized after miracle motorbike recovery
items.description: A woman in her 40s has been arrested and charged with fraud and possessing counterfeit notes after allegedly using the money to buy a second-hand motorbike from a teenager in North Queensland.
